assign.outcome: **One Durable Object per topic is the right MVP default; the whole stack costs $0 at 100 users, ~$20/month at 10k, ~$150-200/month at 1M.** 43 log entries (28 established, 8 contested, 3 speculation), --check clean. Static assets + one Worker on run_worker_first (no main yet); D1 only when a visitor writes; R2 for media/logs with event notifications -> Queues; KV only for published snapshots, never per-visitor writes. Real, unmitigated risk: a single hot topic hits the 500-1,000 req/s per-object ceiling long before account totals do, and no documented runtime re-sharding pattern exists. Wrangler bundles npm deps by default; recommend the no-new-dependency law bind the Worker too, matching /notes/auth's WebCrypto-plus-D1-binding precedent.
